gloss: to roll; to tumble; to roll over

definitions.gloss: to roll; to tumble; to roll over
definitions.explanation: Of a person or object: to roll, tumble, or roll over, often suddenly or repeatedly. Frequently describes someone rolling around on the ground or floor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{坂道|さかみち}→坂道：08166_sakamichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{転|ころ}げ⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{芝生|しばふ}→芝生：03196_shibafu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{転|ころ}げ⟦{回|まわ}った→回る：01150_mawaru⟧。
examples.english: The children rolled around on the lawn.

examples.japanese: ⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧おかしさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、おなか⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|かか}えて→抱える：02031_kakaeru⟧{転|ころ}げて⟦{笑|わら}った→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
examples.english: It was so funny that we rolled around laughing, holding our sides.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧). Nearly synonymous with ⟦{転|ころ}がる→転がる：02571_korogaru⟧, but {転|ころ}げる more often appears in compound verbs and emphasizes a vigorous, tumbling motion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {転|ころ}げ⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: to tumble down
- {転|ころ}げ⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧: to roll around
- {転|ころ}げて⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧: to roll around laughing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{転|ころ}がる→転がる：02571_korogaru⟧: to roll — the more common, neutral verb; {転|ころ}げる sounds livelier and is favored in the compounds above.
